name: B10-0423/2026 – After § 6 – Am 2
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming EU anti-corruption strategy
part_text: 6b. Expresses concern regarding scandals and allegations of improper use of EU funds by non-governmental organisations, in particular reports that the Commission awarded grants to non-governmental organisations that then carried out lobbying activities targeting Parliament, which constitutes an undue influence on the EU decision-making process;
